# The adapted line-release test still omits its expected-result assertion message

The adapted asynchronous line_release_on_drop test waits on the shared release future and then checks assert!(success). The assertion has no nonempty message stating the expected release behavior. A nearby comment and branch panic messages do not fill that assertion argument. Keep this diagnostic finding limited to the inspected imported test; it is not a local style rule for vendor layout, proof of a synchronization failure or an authorized dependency edit. No test ran.

Scope: Imported queue test diagnostics.
